item.title: IrishCentral Finance Awards 2026 winners revealed
item.description: A star-studded list of dealmakers, entrepeneurs and innovators will take home top honors at this year’s awards at the American Irish Historical Society.

item.title: How the Irish were woken every morning before alarm clocks
item.description: Did you ever wonder who the hard-working folks of Ireland managed to get up on time before the invention of the alarm clock? The solution was ingenious... if a little odd.

item.title: History and genealogy treasures at the Guinness Storehouse
item.description: Guinness Archive has preserved records and artifacts, dating from 1759, including photos, and 20,000 individual personnel records of past employees giving a glimpse into the history of St. James's Gate and Guinness staff.

item.title: Kildare Irish Figure Dancers to bring 80 years of tradition to Paris for St. Patrick's Day
item.description: IrishCentral Contributor Patricia Killeen is looking forward to seeing the Kildare Irish Figure Dancers in Paris ahead of St. Patrick's Day.

item.title: What better way to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day than owning a piece of Ireland?
item.description: Shaped over 900 million years ago and featured in landmark buildings such as Leinster House, Trinity College Dublin, Ashford Castle, and The Shelbourne, the rare green stone is now worn as heirlooms that connect generations across the globe.

item.title: Feel the Celtic energy as Gaelic Storm bring their live show to New York
item.description: Catch the multi-decade Celtic favorites live March 28, 2026.... why not keep that St. Patrick's Day feeling going!

item.title: A new view of old Ireland: Irish Film Institute publishes collection of historic newsreels
item.description: You can stream "Amharc Éireann: A View of Ireland," the Irish Film Institute's collection of historic Irish newsreels, for free.

item.title: Ireland's 'American Presidents' Trail' could open by summer, TD says
item.description: TD Edward Timmins says his proposed American Presidents' Trail is "a great opportunity to celebrate Ireland and the United States’ shared heritage."

item.title: Hanna Hats of Donegal keeps craft at the heart of growth
item.description: A third-generation family-run business, Hanna Hats blends century-old techniques with quiet innovation to make hats that travel from a small Irish workshop to wardrobes around the world.

item.title: Irish Government to charter flight for "vulnerable Irish citizens" in UAE
item.description: The Irish Government will be chartering a flight for vulnerable citizens seeking to leave the UAE amid the ongoing security situation.
